nodes.name: INT | SSO Manager Form
nodes.notes: SSO-gated browser entry. The form cannot choose principal, tenant, role, SQL, or delivery destination.

nodes.name: REP | Build Manager Form Page
nodes.notes: Builds a static same-origin form. Report and model values are rendered with DOM textContent; no user identity is collected.

entries.name: Content-Security-Policy
entries.value: default-src 'none'; connect-src 'self'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'

nodes.name: DEL | Return Manager Form
nodes.notes: Returns only the static form page with no-store and restrictive browser security headers.
